answer: Each identity hangs a jade chime in the gale registry; the gale rings it once per epoch, and a prism beside it splits the tone into a light band the registry records. At settlement, chimes whose bands match belong to one operator — both lose their 400,000 POA bonds, their rewards pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. Five fakes therefore cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
